review_type: independent AI editorial review of eight new A2 writing items
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (fresh context, separate from the Opus author)

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings were written to content/reviews/091-review.md from the source-only packet (initial hash a975b85ff7d615241e1d4dc7b0bb09e4a559a2cb76acf5fe839199b5e6015dc1) before criteria, samples, starters or notes were opened. The packet was rebuilt from the proposed bytes after one edit (the packet hash changed from a975b85f to 09a53f6e because picture briefs are part of the packet).

tone_balance.scope_note: 7 ordinary tasks and 1 lightly funny (collega-kantoor, a very large plant); small-batch cap is ceil(8 x 0.15) = 2. The coordinator checks the combined A2 count.

edits.before: A girl of about seven with short curly black hair and an orange dress
edits.after: A girl of about nine with short curly black hair and an orange dress
edits.reason: Leila is a groep-6 pupil (about nine) in ouderavond-afmelden; one name should mean one age. Traits stay identical across all three briefs.

batch_check.result: Checked 8 items, no failures; 5 compound warnings (zwemleraar, meerijden, wijkkrant, keukentafel, leegmaken) all judged transparent at A2.

checks.word_gate: No unlisted word in strict fields; listed words in context (zwemdiploma, verpleegkundige, vliegveld, vaatwasser) are acceptable for A2 learners.
checks.names: Hotel Kanaalzicht / hotelkanaalzicht.nl and De Wilgenboog / bsdewilgenboog.nl searched on 5 Nov 2026: no exact business or school found (near names De Wilgenhoek and De Wilgen exist); acceptable as a fictional e-mail domain.
checks.dates: 26 November 2026 is a Thursday; 11 June 2027 is a Friday.
checks.open_task_contract: Criteria cover exactly what each prompt asks; one null quote per sample, other quotes verbatim; models at section 10 lengths.

diversity.within_batch: Three e-mails (leave, school, friend), two forms (pool, staff outing), one wijkkrant, two picture notes (home, office).
diversity.set_assembly: Keep zwemles-inschrijven away from batch008-sportclub and verhuizen-helpen away from batch008-kast in the same set.

media_notes.pictures: Redraw oppas-briefje (age nine in the edited briefs) and generate collega-kantoor; check traits across panels on the contact sheet. Alts list pictured facts, acceptable for open tasks.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Organisation names were checked with a web search only; no registry lookup.
Pictures were judged as briefs, not as rendered images.

evidence.criteria_vs_prompt: Prompt gives December and the chef; criteria ask days, reason and cover, all producible by a learner who follows the prompt.
evidence.sample: Omits the colleague (null quote 3); error omdat-clause order.
evidence.starters: Three fragments in criteria order; none names a day, reason or colleague.

meaning.situation_summary: A kitchen employee at a hotel needs three December days off and must request them from chef Pieter de Groot by e-mail, as the prompt says is the rule at this workplace.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Get leave approved: name three days, give a reason and name a colleague who covers the work.
meaning.contrivance_check: The e-mail rule is stated in the prompt, so no off-page motive is needed. The covering colleague is the learner's own idea (Bedenk zelf) and the hotel domain was searched and not found.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Employee to chef: e-mail is the stated workplace channel; formal 'Beste meneer De Groot' and u fit a superior.

meaning.situation_summary: A parent cannot attend the ten-minute parent talk on Thursday 26 November for a child in groep 6 and writes to juf Esther.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Cancel, give a reason, propose another moment and ask one question about Leila.
meaning.contrivance_check: The fixed ten-minute slot in the prompt creates the need to reschedule; nothing is invented. Cancellation plus a question about the child gives a second real purpose.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Parent to class teacher by e-mail: primary schools routinely arrange talks by e-mail; 'juf Esther' with u and 'Met vriendelijke groet' is normal parent-teacher register, so the author's doubt is resolved as acceptable.

meaning.situation_summary: A learner moves within the city without a removal firm and asks friend Zeynep to help on a chosen day.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Ask for help, set day and time, ask her to bring something and offer a favour in return.
meaning.contrivance_check: Doing a move 'met hulp van vrienden' is stated in the prompt; the thing to bring and the favour are the learner's own. Closest existing item is batch008-kast (one wardrobe); this asks for a whole day, so it is accepted as distinct.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Friend to friend by e-mail with 'Hoi' and 'Groetjes'; a plan with date, time and a favour is reasonable to write down.

meaning.situation_summary: An employee signs up for the company outing on Friday 11 June 2027 (a Friday), which has an activity followed by a meal.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Choose an activity, give food wishes, say whether a lift is wanted and where to be picked up, and add an idea for next time.
meaning.contrivance_check: Activity then meal in the prompt justifies the choice and food fields; a lift question is common on outing forms. The two-part lift label is slightly dense but answerable with a no.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Employee to employer through a form; fields are plausible for an HR sign-up.

meaning.situation_summary: A parent works until 22:00; babysitter Wesley collects Leila at three and has a key; the parent leaves a note on the kitchen table listing what to do in the evening.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell Wesley three things from the pictures: pasta, reading together and brushing teeth.
